scope_note: All 17 jit functions are launched from Python except the first _fwd_none_diag_kernel in lightning_attn2_parallel.py, which is shadowed by a second definition of the same name (dead code). README says tested with triton 2.0/2.1-nightly. Public entry lightning_attn_func (ops/lightning_attn_interface.py) dispatches: s=None -> no_decay, variant='chunk_loop' (default) -> lightning_attn2, 'parallel' -> lightning_attn2_parallel; d>128 is split into 64/32/16-wide head-dim chunks and partial outputs summed; e padded to a power of 2.

families.family: lightning attention-2 with per-head exponential decay (chunk-loop variant)
families.reference: candidate (library torch ref linear_attn): M[h,i,j] = exp(-s[h]*(i-j)) if j<=i else 0; o = ((q @ k.transpose(-1,-2)) * M) @ v; backward = autograd w.r.t. q,k,v (no grad for s)
open_decisions: decay parameterisation: kernel uses exp(-s_h*(i-j)) with s = per-head slope (comment calls it 'log lambda'; actual lambda = exp(-s))
no softmax, no 1/sqrt(d) scale, no normaliser/denominator
s shape (h,1,1) fp32 shared across batch, non-differentiable
whether to follow torch ref's intermediate cast of (qk*M) to q.dtype (float64 ref drops it)
families.notes: Layout (b,h,n,d)/(b,h,n,e) contiguous; any n (masked); d must be a power of 2 >=16 (tl.arange(0,d), no d-mask) and e a multiple of min(next_pow2(e),32) (interface pads e). Inputs upcast to fp32 and tl.dot on fp32 operands -> TF32 by default on Ampere (precision deviation). Intra/inter block split is algebraically exact (decay exp(-s*(BLOCK-j))*exp(-s*i)). bwd: intra kernel writes, inter kernel read-modify-writes dq/dk/dv in output dtype (extra rounding). Interface bug: is_support(dim)=16 % dim rejects d or e in {1,2,4,8,16}. Large d/e fp32 tiles may stress A6000's ~99KB smem.

families.family: lightning attention-2 with decay, fully-parallel variant
families.reference: same candidate as chunk-loop variant: ((q @ k^T) * M) @ v with M[h,i,j]=exp(-s[h]*(i-j))*[j<=i]
open_decisions: same decay/normalisation decisions as the chunk-loop variant
input domain: n must be a multiple of 256 (NUM_BLOCK = n//256; kv/none-diag kernels unmasked, tail rows of torch.empty output never written)
families.notes: Selected via lightning_attn_func(..., variant='parallel'). Per-block KV states stored in fp32 (b,h,n/256,d,e) and prefix-reduced with block_decay=exp(-256*s). No repo test covers this variant. Duplicate definition of _fwd_none_diag_kernel: only the second (CBLOCK-tiled) one is used. TF32 dot on fp32-upcast inputs.

families.family: causal linear attention without decay (lightning attention-2, s=None)
families.reference: o = torch.tril(q @ k.transpose(-1,-2)) @ v  (== linear_attn(q,k,v,None)); backward = autograd w.r.t. q,k,v
families.notes: Same layout/domain constraints as the decay variant (d power of 2 >=16, e multiple of block, contiguous). No scaling, no normalisation, inclusive diagonal. TF32 dot on fp32-upcast inputs.

families.reference: F.rms_norm(x, (x.shape[-1],), weight=None, eps=eps); backward = autograd w.r.t. x
families.notes: Row-wise over last dim, N*elem_size < 64KB. Deviation: for fp16 inputs eps is silently raised to max(eps,1.6e-5). rstd saved in fp32. bwd loads x/dy in native dtype (promoted by fp32 rstd). Output stored with input row stride.
